about: Every music bed the film can use, with how to rebuild it. tools/audio/use_music.sh <id> rebuilds the bed in .work/audio/render/music_bed.wav, validates it and copies its beat map to tools/audio/beatmap.json. The film then re-snaps to the new map (MASTER_PLAN 6.2: a swap changes no picture work beyond that). Rubric scores and the selection are in docs/media-provenance.json.

original.title: Pebble launch cue (original score)
original.why: Chosen: no Mixkit candidate reached the 70/100 pass mark (MASTER_PLAN 6.2 gate), so the fallback score was composed to the film plan.

mixkit-431.title: Young Trizzy 02
mixkit-431.why: Alternate 1 by rubric score (67/100): best structure, but trap 808s put 80 % of its energy below 150 Hz and SoundAnalysis hears its bells as a ringtone or telephone in 2 of 3 windows.

mixkit-282.title: Sweet September
mixkit-282.why: Alternate 2 (66/100): a tight lo-fi hip-hop beat, but 87 % of its energy sits below 150 Hz (fails the small-speaker check) and it stops abruptly.

mixkit-79.title: The Journey
mixkit-79.why: Alternate 3 (64/100, the best that passes every gate): native 90 BPM and a long final chord, but a serious film-score mood with brass-like swells, not low-key.
